title: Activity 1.1.1 - CIA Triad Card Game
summary: Drag scenario cards onto the CIA Triad x Information States matrix to practice classifying confidentiality, integrity, and availability concerns.
body: Match each scenario card to the correct intersection of Confidentiality, Integrity, or Availability and the information state it involves: Storage, Transmission, or Processing.
Drag a card onto the matrix, or click a card and then click a cell. Use Check My Answers to see how many are correct, and Reset to shuffle and try again.
